boundary_ok: Boundary files OK; remaining files checked during conversion
candidate_summary: Confirmed extrasystoles cannot be determined. {count} premature/ectopic beat candidates. This is not a clinical extrasystole count.

footer: EASY ECG | Unconfirmed automatic review notes
representative: Representative midpoint; no statement of normality
markers: Dots: unconfirmed QRS; green = usable by heuristic, gray = excluded.
red_line: Red line: premature beat candidate. Filtered curve for review only; no ST/QT assessment.
unverified_time: Device date / timezone not independently verified.

checking: Checking device index, SCP structure and CRCs ...
cli_description: PC-80B: local conversion and experimental ECG review
help_gain: PDF gain factor; default 2. Raw exports are unchanged.
help_missing: Explicitly allow incomplete/damaged input; split gaps
help_full: Include all raw samples in an additional PDF
help_waveforms: Include up to six raw excerpts in local AI context
help_ai: Explicitly send AI context to Ollama
help_remote: Explicitly send context to a remote HTTPS endpoint
emergency: For acute chest pain, breathlessness, fainting or severe dizziness, call the local emergency number (112 in the EU). Suspected heart problems require medical assessment; this report does not replace a clinical ECG.
limitations: All findings are unconfirmed candidates. Categories overlap and must not be added as extrasystoles. Missing markers do not exclude disease. Flat signal is excluded from rhythm counting; technical/contact problems are possible, but a rhythm cause is not ruled out. Long RR intervals can reflect missed QRS. Irregularity does not prove atrial fibrillation.
time_basis: Times are local device times from SCP metadata, with no verified timezone. Copy times are ignored. Files are joined only within the indexed range with matching time and calibration. Missing data remain separate parts.
method_filter: Analysis uses a configurable zero-phase bandpass (default 0.5-40 Hz) and evidence-based 50/60 Hz notch. QRS combines WFDB XQRS, NeuroKit2 and SWT, timing, shape and amplitude checks. At least two detectors must support counted beats. Artifact, disagreement, recording edges and flat segments restrict analysis. Agreement does not prove correct detection.
method_rhythm: Local RR and morphology screening includes premature candidates, couplets, runs, bigeminy/trigeminy and persistent irregularity. Energy width is not a clinical QRS duration. Default review thresholds: long RR at least 2 s; 10s rate median above 100/min or below 50/min; 30s RR CV above 0.18 and RMSSD above 0.12 s; persistent irregularity at least 90 s. Actual parameters are in analysis.json.
method_limits: Public reference tests are development checks, not clinical validation for PC-80B motion artifacts. No validated assessment of infarction/ischemia, ST, QT/QTc, conduction blocks, pacemakers or definitive AF/VT/PAC/PVC classification. Electrode lead and amplitude calibration have not been clinically verified. See docs/METHODS.md and docs/VALIDATION.md.
handover: Give the clinician summary.pdf, review_strips.pdf, optional full_curves.pdf and EDF+ files. Record symptoms/times, electrode position, medicines and activity. Confirm import support with the practice. Unfiltered EDF+/WFDB and original device words in raw.npz are retained; unknown status bits are not diagnoses. AI is optional with no automatic upload; its text is separate and unvalidated.
incomplete: INCOMPLETE INPUT: {count} files missing or rejected. See manifest.json.
pdf_gain: PDF gain: {gain}; review strips {mm} mm/mV. Display only; raw calibration is unchanged. High amplitudes may be clipped in panels and are marked.
ectopic_run_candidate: Run of at least three ectopic candidates
wide_complex_run_candidate: Fast run of different complexes (review rhythm)
long_rr_candidate: Long RR interval with adequate signal
signal_dropout: Nearly flat signal; measurement/contact issue possible
persistent_irregular_rr_candidate: Persistent RR irregularity (not an AF diagnosis)
output_not_empty: Output folder must be new or empty.
output_inside: Choose output outside the input folder.
invalid_input: Input must be an Easy ECG folder or ZIP.
gui_display: GUI needs a graphical desktop; use easyecg run for headless operation.
